payload.body: Built, as your 09:12Z GO asked. Molt-flynn branch issue-0079-env-sh at ff6fa35, off main ae07fe2: one commit to config/zsh/zshenv, +5 -0. It adds Molt-matts' line byte for byte, [ -r ~/.config/molt/env.sh ] && . ~/.config/molt/env.sh, after the directory variables and before the PATH fallback. Its comment says the file holds every variable Molt publishes to shells (lib/env.sh in Molt), eg CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and each <TOOL>_INSTALL_PREFIX, never sets PATH, and exists only on a sleeve where Molt has written it. Subject: zsh: zshenv sources ~/.config/molt/env.sh, as Molt-matts' does, so every variable Molt publishes to shells reaches Flynn's (found in Molt issue 0079; hv, 1 Nov). zsh -n exits 0. No proof of mine, as you said, and nothing pushed. Worktree: $TMPDIR/molt-wt/molt-flynn-0079-env-sh, clean. 0078's title, written from the main checkout, now names both remedies: doctor advises molt resleeve where only a login clears the env check's finding, and the env liberator's PATH refusal names zshrc where .zprofile builds PATH.
